notes: This is a version-specific browser adapter, not a supported replacement for the Desktop preload API.
Browser workbench requires same-origin Dashboard plugin execution plus its documented fetchJSON and buildWsUrl SDK methods.
Only api calls using Dashboard profile routing are supported; the desktop also supports local pools and multiple registered gateway connections.
Native-only APIs fail closed, return explicit unavailable values, or are harmless no-ops; no arbitrary filesystem or shell access is emulated.
